title: You are my all in all
lyrics_original: You are my strength when I am weak
You are the treasure that I seek
You are my all in all
Seeking You as a precious jewel
Lord, to give up I'd be a fool
You are my all in all
Taking my sin, my cross, my shame
Rising again I bless Your name
You are my all in all
When I fall down You pick me up
When I am dry You fill my cup
You are my all in all

bible_verses.telugu: అందుకునా కృప నీకు చాలును, బలహీనతయందు నాశక్తి పరిపూర్ణమగుచున్నదని ఆయన నాతో చెప్పెను. కాగా క్రీస్తు శక్తి నామీద నిలిచియుండు నిమిత్తము, విశేషముగా నా బలహీనతలయందె
bible_verses.english: But he said to me, 'My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.' Therefore I will boast all the more gladly about my weaknesses, so that Christ’s power may rest on me.

bible_verses.telugu: పరలోకరాజ్యము, పొలములో దాచబడిన ధనమును పోలియున్నది. ఒక మనుష్యుడు దాని కనుగొని దాచి పెట్టి, అది దొరికిన సంతోషముతో వెళ్లి, తనకు కలిగిన దంతయు అమి్మ ఆ పొలమును కొనును.
bible_verses.english: The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it again, and then in his joy went and sold all he had and bought that field.

bible_verses.telugu: వారువధింపబడిన గొఱ్ఱపిల్ల, శక్తియు ఐశ్వర్యమును జ్ఞానమును బలమును ఘనతయు మహిమయు స్తోత్రమును పొందనర్హుడని గొప్ప స్వరముతో చెప్పుచుండిరి.
bible_verses.english: In a loud voice they were saying: 'Worthy is the Lamb, who was slain, to receive power and wealth and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and praise!'

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, You truly are my strength when I am weak and the greatest treasure of my life. Forgive me for the times I look for fulfillment anywhere else but in You. Teach my heart to surrender fully to Your grace, knowing that Your strength is made perfect in my weakness. You are the Lamb of God, worthy of all my love, praise, and devotion today and forever. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, You truly are my strength when I am weak and the greatest treasure of my life. Forgive me for the times I look for fulfillment anywhere else but in You. Teach my heart to surrender fully to Your grace, knowing that Your strength is made perfect in my weakness. You are the Lamb of God, worthy of all my love, praise, and devotion today and forever. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: When we feel drained or overwhelmed, this song tenderly points us back to the ultimate source of life: Jesus. He doesn't just give us strength; He becomes our strength in our weakest moments. Like a hidden treasure or a precious jewel, His presence outweighs anything else this world offers. As you sing today, let your heart rest in His complete sufficiency, offering Him the praise He so richly deserves as the worthy Lamb of God.
